newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks down in morning after early rise.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks down in morning after early rise.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were lower in Wednesday morning trade after opening slightly higher following Wall Street's record climb on Tuesday. But brokers said that market sentiment was weak in the aftermath of the Nikkei average's plunge below 19,000 yesterday.
As of 0014 GMT, the benchmark Nikkei 225 average was down 54.80 points or 0.29 percent at 18,841.39. Its March futures lost 10 points to 18,870.
Brokers said the Nikkei average could be heading towards the 18,500 level.
